name: Fortune Tiles Gold
summary:
Test your luck and skill in this captivating tile-matching adventure! The goal is to make matching lines of 3 or more tiles of the same color. As you clear the tiles, new and different ones will take their place. Your objective is to clear all the marked tiles to advance to the next level.

Explore two distinct game modes: Timed for those who love a challenge, and Endless for a more relaxing experience. Along the way, utilize powerful bonus-ups like the magic rainbow, the hammer, and encounter a plethora of magical creatures. With excellent sound effects, enchanting music, and intuitive gameplay, Fortune Tiles Gold is a polished casual puzzle that rewards both planning and quick thinking.
